name: studio_load_revision
description: Load a workspace GLB model in the Studio view. Use fileName for an exact version or modelName for the latest version in that model family. If both are omitted, load the most recently updated workspace model. Completion is confirmed by Studio modelLoaded.

modelName.description: Model family name; omit to select by fileName or most recently updated model

fileName.description: Exact version file name, such as hi3d-chair_2.glb; historical files may not have the hi3d- prefix

name: studio_arrange
description: Run automatic arrangement for the model in the current Studio view. Returns the arrangement result and build-plate overflow information. If the model is oversized, the panel waits for the user to decide. The user can cancel from the Studio progress overlay.

profileId.description: Arrangement profile ID; omit to use the current Studio setting

plateMode.description: Single-plate or multi-plate mode; omit to use the current Studio setting

name: studio_export_3mf
description: Open the Studio print-plan panel. This tool only opens the panel; the user downloads or sends from there. Register generated files only after an export3mf or modelSend event.

name: studio_get_state
description: Read the current Hi3D Studio view state: loaded asset and revision, arrangement state, physical dimensions in millimeters, part names, face count, and vertex count. An unloaded view returns ready=false and assetId=null; call studio_load_revision before model operations. This tool reads the built-in Hi3D view, not Bambu Studio or another external slicer.

name: studio_capture_view
description: Capture the current Studio viewport as a PNG, register it as a screenshot artifact, and return its artifactId for use as an image input.
